name: OmaReach
author: Mateus Pim
description: Black out monitor edges you can't reach, like the top of a tall rotated screen, and keep the bar and tiled windows in the part you can, with optional fills, including a btop-style system dashboard.

barWidget.description: Black out unreachable display edges, set in pixels, or fill them with a theme color, the wallpaper, the Omarchy logo, a clock or a live btop-style dashboard of GPU, CPU, memory and more.
